description: This file defines the IVersionStore interface that provides methods for accessing runtime-configurable version strategies for grain interfaces in Orleans. It includes methods for retrieving strategies and their mappings, and indicates whether the store is enabled.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Property indicating whether the version store is enabled.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategies
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a mapping from grain interface types to their compatibility strategies.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategies
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a mapping from grain interface types to their selector strategies.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the default compatibility strategy.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the default selector strategy.
